notes.title: Game Update after a long time
notes.content:
- You can now make enemy monsters your allies (under development. Currently only monsters in the first area)
- You can now place items in some places, such as your house
- Items can now be lifted and thrown
- Jump system has been changed
- Multiplayer mode has been removed

Since this update, it is estimated that the plot of the game will be significantly changed
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36217019/2de022b6f4ee9954de309010e87632b7e390cc54.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Game Update & Notice
notes.content:
- Fall speed has been changed
- Added one weapon and armor
- Added one new stage

-Notice-
The game was expected to be completed in 2020, but is expected to take much longer than planned
We are very sorry, but thank you for your cooperation

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36217019/4d753e34e86aeefa06c8d87f503e4ef2d40056a3.jpg[/img]
